content.title: BYD Announces Electric Minivan with 559 Miles Range
content.caption: China's BYD unveils the BYD Whale, an electric minivan with an impressive 559 miles range.

slides.heading: BYD Announces Electric Minivan with 559 Miles Range
slides.text: China's BYD unveils the BYD Whale, an electric minivan with an impressive 559 miles range.

slides.heading: Announcement Details
slides.text: BYD announces the launch of the BYD Whale, a high-performance electric minivan with a range of 559 miles.

slides.heading: Vehicle Specifications
slides.text: The BYD Whale boasts impressive dimensions and advanced features, including a 123-inch wheelbase and a sensor cluster on its forehead.
